name: Toolbar allows selecting drawing tools and modifying brush size
description: Verify selecting Pen, Eraser, Flood Fill, Dither, and Brush Size updates the active tool state and controls.

planSteps.description: Verify the left toolbar is visible containing the Pen, Eraser, Flood Fill, Dither Brush, Eyedropper, Marquee, Line, Rectangle, and Ellipse buttons
Click the Eraser tool button in the left toolbar
Verify the Eraser tool is active with highlighted styling in the tool dock
Click the Flood Fill tool button in the left toolbar
Verify the Flood Fill tool is active and displays the fill mode modifier button in the top options bar
Click the Dither Brush tool button in the left toolbar
Verify the Dither tool is active and displays the Bayer matrix button in the top options bar
Change the brush size slider in the top context options bar
Verify the brush size display in the top context options bar reflects the updated size
